findings.description: Only RecipientRefused is caught inside the loop. Any other mailer failure (connection error, timeout, SMTP server error) propagates out of send_campaign. The loop stops partway, so the remaining subscribers are never mailed, and the report of who was already sent is discarded because it is never returned. A retry of the campaign would then re-send to the subscribers who already received it, since no record of them survives.
findings.suggestion: Handle other exceptions per recipient and record them in the report, for example a `failed` dict, or attach the partial report to the raised exception so callers can resume without duplicates.
findings.title: A single non-refusal send error aborts the whole campaign and the report is lost
